title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An unforgettable day in Montserrat with Milo
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An unforgettable day in Montserrat with Milo!

My day trip to Montserrat and wine tasting with Milo was a highlight of my time in Spain. He's incredibly knowledgeable and brought the monastery, the history of the mountain and the local wines to life with fascinating stories, without it ever feeling like a lecture. The views were breathtaking and the wines were excellent. I was traveling solo, and Milo made me feel welcome and well looked after the whole day. Everything ran smoothly from start to finish. If you're thinking about a Montserrat tour, book it with Milo. Highly recommend!
